notes.text:
This update for exiv2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-49275: out of bounds read in CrwMap::decodeBasic (bsc#1277791).
- CVE-2026-68546: heap out-of-bounds read in RemoteIo when reading block-aligned remote CRW files (bsc#1277579).
- CVE-2026-68547: heap out-of-bounds write in RemoteIo when reading from a malicious remote server (bsc#1277591).
